name: Narrow 4-2-2-2

slots.why: Support full-back is the only wide player on the left, so he provides the width.
Central defender. Cover is the alternate.
Central defender on the right. Cover is the alternate, but only one Cover can be used.
Support full-back on the right, the only width on that side.
Ball-winning midfielder wins the ball back and starts the press.
Deep-lying playmaker distributes from the base of the midfield.
Shadow striker presses from the half-space and runs beyond the strikers into the box.
Attacking midfielder (Support) links the pivot with the strikers and creates from the other half-space.
Deep-lying forward holds up the ball and links with the attacking midfielders. Complete Forward is the alternate.
Advanced Forward runs in behind the defence. Poacher is the alternate.

description: A narrow 4-2-2-2 with a double pivot, two attacking midfielders in the half-spaces and two strikers, giving six players in the middle of the pitch.
whyGood: Six central players make a compact, well-connected team that overloads the middle and presses as a unit.
whyThisShape: The two attacking midfielders sit in the half-spaces between the opposition's centre-backs and full-backs, and with the double pivot and two strikers, six players occupy the middle of the pitch. Passes between them are short, and the team presses as a compact unit. The only width comes from the full-backs, so the shape depends on them.
whenToUse: When your best players are central and you lack wingers, especially against a team with two central midfielders who will be overrun.
whenNotToUse: Against sides that attack down the flanks and outnumber your full-backs, and when your full-backs cannot cover a whole flank.

instructionRationale.Fairly Narrow: The whole team plays through the centre, where it has the numbers.
instructionRationale.Shorter Passing: Short passes suit six players close together in the middle.
instructionRationale.Higher Tempo: Moves the ball quickly between the central players.
instructionRationale.Counter-Press: Presses at once after losing the ball; with six players near it, it is quickly won back.
instructionRationale.Higher Line of Engagement: Presses higher up the pitch to keep the play in the opponent's half.
instructionRationale.Standard Defensive Line: A balanced line keeps the defence compact.

keyRequirements: Full-backs who provide all the width
A ball-winner and a playmaker in the pivot
A shadow striker and a creative attacking midfielder
